name: Roasted Sockeye Salmon, Potato & Green Bean "Salade Niçoise" with Eggs

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry the fresh produce.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg new potatoes
0.68 kg green beans
1 ½ small pkgs grape tomatoes
3 heads butter (Boston) lettuce

instructions.primary_message: Depending on size, halve or quarter potatoes into bite-sized pieces. Transfer to a baking sheet pan.
Trim and discard ends of the green beans; transfer to a second baking sheet. Drizzle potatoes and green beans with oil, season with spices, and toss to coat; spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
2 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
1 ½ tsp Italian seasoning
¾ tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast, tossing halfway through, until veggies are golden brown and fork-tender, about 20 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
While the veggies are roasting, pat the salmon dry with paper towels and place, skin-side down, on a third baking sheet. Drizzle with oil and season with spices.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.68 kg sockeye salmon fillet
1 tbsp extra virgin olive oil
¾ tsp Italian seasoning
½ tsp salt
3 pinch black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add baking sheet to the oven and roast until salmon is opaque and flakes easily with a fork, about 10 minutes. Remove from oven and set aside to cool slightly.
Meanwhile, halve tomatoes and place on a large plate.
Peel and thinly slice shallots into rings; add to the plate with the tomatoes.
Halve eggs lengthwise; add to the plate.
Separate lettuce into leaves and divide between plates. Top with potatoes, green beans, salmon, tomatoes, shallots, eggs, olives, and capers. Serve with vinaigrette on the side and enjoy!
instructions.secondary_message:
1 cup Kalamata olives, pitted
3 tbsp capers
½ cup French vinaigrette
